notes.title: Our Kickstarter Coming-Soon Page and Demo are Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello adventurers![/h3]

As you have probably figured out, we are still hard at work developing the game.
However, we feel comfortable enough with Anitons that we've decided to take it to the next step and release a [url=https://bit.ly/3vf6JeM]Kickstarter Coming-Soon page for it![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/2af15cd48755149466743b5f1dca27ac5c0b06a6.png[/img]

There, you can follow us to receive a notification when the proper campaign goes out. By following our Coming-Soon page, you are helping us spread the awareness of Anitons to other people, and by that - create an even more awesome community for the game. Please go and check it out!
We also plan on doing customary "Early Bird" packs, so you can grab an early discount. It's on us!

... but that's not the end of the news!

While the game is still in heavy development, with the help of the funds we've previously secured, we were able to work on a demo for the game! 
 
The first demo is live as you read the post. There, you will have a chance to experience a very early introduction to the world of Anitons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/643b6dd95ccf44b8e24fd8bb1d6c27d1ac0c6525.gif[/img]

The second demo will come out along with the launch of our full-on proper Kickstarter campaign, so stay put! It will be a continuation of the previous demo. While the funds we've previously secured were enough to prepare the two demos, we still need your help in bringing Anitons to life.

We would like to thank everyone who has shown their support throughout this amazing journey. We hope those little demos will show just how much love we’ve put into this project and that you will enjoy it too. Again - go and check out our Coming-Soon page!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39430525/0c30b4cf2fa0db375e6c28b91a892f4463b89911.gif[/img]

If you want to become a part of an ever-growing community of Anitons fans, check out our [url=https://bit.ly/3azUOkJ]Discord server[/url]! There, you can talk about the project all you want, find out the newest updates on the game, and even talk to the devs directly! 
 
Meanwhile, keep your heads up for future updates on the game. There’s more to come!
 
Stay put! ❤️🐐
